blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — San Juan City Mayor Francis Zamora and Chief Operating Officer Mark Lapid of the Tourism Infrastructure and Enterprise Zone Authority (Tieza) led the groundbreaking ceremony of the Pinaglabanan Tourist Center and Souvenir Shop on Thursday, Nov. 12, 2026, at the historic Pinaglabanan Shrine in San Juan City. The ₱17.1-million tourism infrastructure project is a joint initiative of the San Juan and Tieza, which is aimed at further strengthening the city’s position as a premier historical and cultural tourism destination in Metro Manila.
